questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct statement about magnetic poles?

options.text: Like poles repel and unlike poles attract
A magnet can have a single isolated north pole

questions.explanation: Like poles (N-N or S-S) repel each other, while unlike poles (N-S) attract each other. Magnetic poles always come in pairs -- you cannot isolate a single north or south pole.

questions.stem: Which of the following materials is NOT magnetic?
questions.explanation: Copper is not a magnetic material. The main magnetic materials are iron, cobalt, nickel, and steel (which contains iron). Copper, aluminium, plastic, and wood are non-magnetic.
